findings.text: The reviewed node's done_when carries an arm 'the worker prompt asks for a rubric self-check recorded in the manifest before delivery', and the plan section names prompts.py for it, but reckon/crew/prompts.py is unchanged across 411ddcee..5c41e9e07 and no rubric self-check mechanism exists anywhere in reckon/crew; the arm is unimplemented and the manifest does not disclose the gap.

The done_when asks for 'one escalation obligation naming the open findings', but the escalation is written only to the durable pointer's repair_dispatch field and reckon/crew/obligations.py reads neither REPAIR_DISPATCH_FIELD nor the 'escalated' status, so no obligation row surfaces it; the test asserts the pointer row rather than the obligation the measure names. The manifest discloses this under evidence_inputs.

stored_review_descending_from reaches for the private merge._is_ancestor while reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2426 already owns _revision_is_ancestor for the same head/base ancestry question used by dispatch_claims; two private ancestor call paths now exist for one capability.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the node goal is to run landed-work review, repair and diff re-review for up to three rounds with no coordinator and keep a hand-repaired run reviewable; reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:884-895 opens the second and third rounds and records one escalation, and reckon/crew/review_records.py:1461 accepts a review from a later head, but the goal's rubric self-check prompt arm is absent.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/test_review_repair_runs_without_the_coordinator.py and tests/test_one_automatic_repair_round_per_run.py; both ran in the recorded gate (89 passed, EXIT=0), but the rubric-self-check arm has no test and the escalation arm is measured as a pointer row, not the obligation the done_when states.
VERDICT write_paths: the operative grant in the reviewed run's live pointer node.write_paths holds 13 paths (the four review_repair_dispatch/test_one_automatic/review_records/crew_run_commands additions were granted by the resume advice); 9 of the 10 changed paths lie inside it and tests/test_a_disposed_finding_ends_its_repair_round.py lies outside, as the manifest states.
VERDICT manifest: read the reviewed run's manifest; it records status complete, four commits, gate-head.log 89 passed EXIT=0 and gate-base.log 1 failed 82 passed EXIT=1, a negative control forcing the one-round cap, and one out-of-scope path under blockers/outside_scope, but it does not disclose the missing rubric self-check arm.
VERDICT diff: read 0d986a361, b9e421aea, 76b9f1829 and 5c41e9e07 against 411ddcee; the code changes stamp finding ids in review.py, bound repair rounds in recovery_repair_dispatch.py, add stored_review_descending_from and the dispose descent in crew_run_commands.py, and add diff/answers to compose_repair_brief in repair.py.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:dispatch_repair_for_run
SCORE goal_fidelity: 13
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:884 bounds rounds and record escalation and reckon/crew/review_records.py:1461 adds the descent, but reckon/crew/prompts.py:46 was never extended with the done_when's rubric self-check arm.
SCORE evidence: 14
JUSTIFICATION evidence: gate-head.log 89 passed EXIT=0 and gate-base.log 1 failed 82 passed EXIT=1 are recorded, but tests/test_one_automatic_repair_round_per_run.py:302 asserts the pointer escalation rather than an obligation and no gate covers the self-check arm.
SCORE scope_discipline: 15
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: 9 of 10 changed paths are inside the live pointer's node.write_paths and only tests/test_a_disposed_finding_ends_its_repair_round.py:224 lies outside, disclosed in the manifest blockers: and outside_scope: fields.
SCORE durability: 16
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_one_automatic_repair_round_per_run.py is proven by a real negative control (`AUTOMATIC_REPAIR_ROUND_LIMIT=1` fails the second, third and escalation arms) and tests/test_review_repair_runs_without_the_coordinator.py:146 adds a divergent-head negative for the descent, though the self-check arm has no test.
SCORE fit: 16
JUSTIFICATION fit: the new names are mechanism-named and free of plan labels, but reckon/crew/review_records.py:1506 borrows merge._is_ancestor where promotion_scope owns the sibling ancestor helper.
SCORE reuse: 17
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the additions extend owners (repair.finding_id in review.py:2856, blocking_findings in recovery_repair_dispatch.py:611, stored_records_for_run in review_records.py:1446) and reuse same_revision and _is_ancestor rather than forking them.
FINDING reckon/crew/prompts.py:46 blocking: the done_when's rubric self-check arm is unimplemented and undisclosed; prompts.py is unchanged and no self-check mechanism exists.
FINDING reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:891 non-blocking: the escalation is recorded on the pointer only and no obligation row surfaces it, so a coordinator reading obligations sees nothing.
FINDING reckon/crew/review_records.py:1506 non-blocking: a second private ancestor call path is introduced beside promotion_scope._revision_is_ancestor.
